items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: you know he was married to Carmen McRae at the time

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I will say this for Billy Ekstine, he really, really tried to help Sarah. I mean from his heart and all the guys, and Diz and Bird, and all the guys, you know and Kenny Clark

you know he was married to Carmen McRae at the time, but everybody got together. They wanted to make it, you know what I mean. And she was just a regular, you know, so she had the talent and she come out of church in Jersey and a choir and she had all the equipment and the main thing is she knew the keyboard, and that's a tremendous help because you can check yourself out anytime, you don't have to depend on bringing somebody in to check you out, you know what I mean, rehearsal. You rehearse yourself. Hahahaha.…
